shloka_text: नारदस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा ऽमृतमयं तदा । प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे लक्ष्मणं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.75.1 ।।
transliteration: nāradasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā 'mṛtamayaṃ tadā | praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe lakṣmaṇaṃ cedamabravīt || 7.75.1 ||
translation: नारदस्य of Narada, तु indeed, तद्वाक्यं that speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, अमृतमयं nectar-like, तदा then, प्रहर्षमतुलं immeasurable joy, लेभे obtained, लक्ष्मणं to Lakshmana, च and, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Then, having heard those nectar-like words of Narada, Rama obtained immeasurable joy and spoke this to Lakshmana.
comments: Rama has the child's body preserved in oil and, summoning the Pushpaka, sets out armed to search his realm -- finding no fault in the west, north or east, he comes south and beside a lake on Mount Shaivala sees an ascetic hanging head-down in fierce penance, and asks him who he is and of what caste.

shloka_text: गच्छ सौम्य द्विजश्रेष्ठं समाश्वासय सुव्रतम् । बालस्य तु शरीरं तत्तैलद्रोण्यां निधापय ।। 7.75.2 ।।
transliteration: gaccha saumya dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ samāśvāsaya suvratam | bālasya tu śarīraṃ tattailadroṇyāṃ nidhāpaya || 7.75.2 ||
translation: गच्छ go, सौम्य O gentle one, द्विजश्रेष्ठं the best of Brahmins, समाश्वासय console, सुव्रतम् the one of good vows, बालस्य of the child, तु indeed, शरीरं body, तत् that, तैलद्रोण्यां in a trough of oil, निधापय cause to be placed
explanation: O gentle one, go and console that best of Brahmins, the one of good vows, and have the child's body preserved in a trough of oil.

shloka_text: गन्धैश्च परमोदारैस्तैलैश्चापि सुगन्धिभिः । यथा न क्षीयते बालस्तथा सौम्य विधीयताम् ।। 7.75.3 ।।
transliteration: gandhaiśca paramodāraistailaiścāpi sugandhibhiḥ | yathā na kṣīyate bālastathā saumya vidhīyatām || 7.75.3 ||
translation: गन्धैः with fragrances, च and, परमोदारैः very excellent, तैलैः with oils, च and, अपि also, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant, यथा so that, न not, क्षीयते wastes away, बालः the child, तथा so, सौम्य O gentle one, विधीयताम् let it be done
explanation: O gentle one, let it be done with very excellent fragrances and fragrant oils so that the child does not waste away.

shloka_text: यथा शरीरो बालस्य गुप्तः सन् शिष्टकर्मणः । विपत्तिः परिभेदो वा न भवेच्च तथा कुरु ।। 7.75.4 ।।
transliteration: yathā śarīro bālasya guptaḥ san śiṣṭakarmaṇaḥ | vipattiḥ paribhedo vā na bhavecca tathā kuru || 7.75.4 ||
translation: यथा so that, शरीरः the body, बालस्य of the child, गुप्तः protected, सन् being, शिष्टकर्मणः of the well-behaved one, विपत्तिः misfortune, परिभेदः injury, वा or, न not, भवेत् may occur, च and, तथा so, कुरु do
explanation: Ensure that the body of the well-behaved child is protected so that no misfortune or injury may occur.

shloka_text: एवमादिश्य काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम् । मनसा पुष्पकं दध्यावागच्छेति महायशाः ।। 7.75.5 ।।
transliteration: evamādiśya kākutstho lakṣmaṇaṃ śubhalakṣaṇam | manasā puṣpakaṃ dadhyāvāgaccheti mahāyaśāḥ || 7.75.5 ||
translation: एवम् thus, आदिश्य having instructed, काकुत्स्थः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, शुभलक्षणम् auspicious-featured, मनसा with his mind, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, दध्यौ meditated upon, आगच्छ come, इति thus, महायशाः the highly renowned one
explanation: Having thus instructed the auspicious-featured Lakshmana, the highly renowned Rama thought of the Pushpaka chariot in his mind, commanding it to come.

shloka_text: इङ्गितं स तु विज्ञाय पुष्पको हेमभूषितः । आजगाम मुहूर्तेन समीपे राघवस्य वै ।। 7.75.6 ।।
transliteration: iṅgitaṃ sa tu vijñāya puṣpako hemabhūṣitaḥ | ājagāma muhūrtena samīpe rāghavasya vai || 7.75.6 ||
translation: इङ्गितम् the hint, सः it, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having understood, पुष्पकः the Pushpaka, हेमभूषितः adorned with gold, आजगाम came, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, समीपे near, राघवस्य of Rama, वै indeed
explanation: Indeed, having understood Rama's mental signal, the gold-adorned Pushpaka chariot arrived near Rama in a moment.

shloka_text: सो ऽब्रवीत्प्रणतो भूत्वा अयमस्मि नराधिप । वश्यस्तव महाबाहो किङ्करः समुपस्थितः ।। 7.75.7 ।।
transliteration: so 'bravītpraṇato bhūtvā ayamasmi narādhipa | vaśyastava mahābāho kiṅkaraḥ samupasthitaḥ || 7.75.7 ||
translation: सः it, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रणतः bowed, भूत्वा having become, अयम् this, अस्मि I am, नराधिप O king of men, वश्यः obedient, तव your, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, किङ्करः servant, समुपस्थितः present
explanation: Having bowed, the Pushpaka spoke, "O king of men, O mighty-armed one, I am your obedient servant, present here."

shloka_text: भाषितं रुचिरं श्रुत्वा पुष्पकस्य नराधिपः । अभिवाद्य महर्षींस्तान् विमानं सो ऽध्यरोहत ।। 7.75.8 ।।
transliteration: bhāṣitaṃ ruciraṃ śrutvā puṣpakasya narādhipaḥ | abhivādya maharṣīṃstān vimānaṃ so 'dhyarohata || 7.75.8 ||
translation: भाषितं spoken words, रुचिरं pleasing, श्रुत्वा having heard, पुष्पकस्य of Pushpaka, नराधिपः the king, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महर्षींस्तान् those great sages, विमानं the aerial chariot, सः he, अध्यरोहत ascended.
explanation: Having heard the pleasing words of Pushpaka, the king (Rama) saluted those great sages and then ascended the aerial chariot.

shloka_text: धनुर्गृहीत्वा तूणी च खड्गं च रुचिरप्रभम् । निक्षिप्य नगरे वीरौ सौमित्रिभरतावुभौ ।। 7.75.9 ।।
transliteration: dhanurgṛhītvā tūṇī ca khaḍgaṃ ca ruciraprabham | nikṣipya nagare vīrau saumitribharatāvubhau || 7.75.9 ||
translation: धनुः bow, गृहीत्वा having taken, तूणी quiver, च and, खड्गं sword, च and, रुचिरप्रभम् of beautiful luster, निक्षिप्य having left, नगरे in the city, वीरौ the two heroes, सौमित्रिभरतौ Lakshmana and Bharata, उभौ both.
explanation: Having taken his bow, quiver, and a beautifully shining sword, and having left both heroes Lakshmana and Bharata in the city, (Rama proceeded).

shloka_text: प्रायात्प्रतीचीं हरितं विचिन्वंश्च ततस्ततः । उत्तरामगमच्छ्रीमान्दिशं हिमवता वृताम् ।। 7.75.10 ।।
transliteration: prāyātpratīcīṃ haritaṃ vicinvaṃśca tatastataḥ | uttarāmagamacchrīmāndiśaṃ himavatā vṛtām || 7.75.10 ||
translation: प्रायात् he went, प्रतीचीं western, हरितं direction, विचिन्वंश्च and searching, ततस्ततः here and there, उत्तराम northern, अगमत् he went, श्रीमान् the glorious one, दिशं direction, हिमवता by the Himalayas, वृताम् covered.
explanation: The glorious Rama proceeded to the western direction, searching everywhere, and then went to the northern direction, which is covered by the Himalayas.

shloka_text: अपश्यमानस्तत्रापि स्वल्पमप्यथ दुष्कृतम् । पूर्वामपि दिशं सर्वामथो ऽपश्यन्नराधिपः ।। 7.75.11 ।।
transliteration: apaśyamānastatrāpi svalpamapyatha duṣkṛtam | pūrvāmapi diśaṃ sarvāmatho 'paśyannarādhipaḥ || 7.75.11 ||
translation: अपश्यमानः not seeing, तत्रापि even there, स्वल्पमपि even a little, अथ then, दुष्कृतम् evil deed, पूर्वामपि even the eastern, दिशं direction, सर्वाम् entire, अथो then, अपश्यत् he saw, नराधिपः the king.
explanation: Not finding even a slight evil deed there (in the north), the king then surveyed the entire eastern direction as well.

translation: प्रविशुद्धसमाचाराम् whose conduct was perfectly pure, आदर्शतलनिर्मलाम् as clear as the surface of a mirror, पुष्पकस्थः seated in Pushpaka, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, तदा then, अपश्यत् he saw, नराधिपः the king.
explanation: Seated in Pushpaka, the mighty-armed king then saw (the entire land) whose conduct was perfectly pure and as clear as the surface of a mirror.

shloka_text: दक्षिणां दिशमाक्रामत्ततो राजर्षिनन्दनः । शैवलस्योत्तरे पार्श्वे ददर्श सुमहत्सरः ।। 7.75.13 ।।
transliteration: dakṣiṇāṃ diśamākrāmattato rājarṣinandanaḥ | śaivalasyottare pārśve dadarśa sumahatsaraḥ || 7.75.13 ||
translation: दक्षिणां southern, दिशम् direction, आक्रामत् proceeded, ततः then, राजर्षिनन्दनः the son of the royal sage (Rama), शैवलस्य of Shaivala, उत्तरे northern, पार्श्वे side, ददर्श saw, सुमहत् very large, सरः lake.
explanation: Then, Rama, the son of the royal sage, proceeded towards the southern direction and on the northern side of Shaivala, he saw a very large lake.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्सरसि तप्यन्तं तापसं सुमहत्तपः । ददर्श राघवः श्रीमाँल्लम्बमानमधोमुखम् ।। 7.75.14 ।।
transliteration: tasminsarasi tapyantaṃ tāpasaṃ sumahattapaḥ | dadarśa rāghavaḥ śrīmāँllambamānamadhomukham || 7.75.14 ||
translation: तस्मिन् in that, सरसि lake, तप्यन्तं performing penance, तापसं an ascetic, सुमहत् very great, तपः penance, ददर्श saw, राघवः Rama, श्रीमान् glorious, लम्बमानम् hanging, अधोमुखम् head downwards.
explanation: In that lake, the glorious Rama saw an ascetic performing very great penance, hanging head downwards.

shloka_text: राघवस्तमुपागम्य तप्यन्तं तप उत्तमम् । उवाच स तदा वाक्यं धन्यस्त्वमसि सुव्रत ।। 7.75.15 ।।
transliteration: rāghavastamupāgamya tapyantaṃ tapa uttamam | uvāca sa tadā vākyaṃ dhanyastvamasi suvrata || 7.75.15 ||
translation: राघवः Rama, तम् him, उपागम्य having approached, तप्यन्तं performing, तपः penance, उत्तमम् excellent, उवाच said, सः he, तदा then, वाक्यं words, धन्यः blessed, त्वम् you, असि are, सुव्रत O ascetic of good vows.
explanation: Rama, having approached him who was performing excellent penance, then spoke these words: "O ascetic of good vows, you are blessed."

shloka_text: कस्यां योन्यां तपोवृद्ध वर्तसे दृढविक्रम । कौतूहलात्त्वां पृच्छामि रामो दाशरथिर्ह्यहम् ।। 7.75.16 ।।
transliteration: kasyāṃ yonyāṃ tapovṛddha vartase dṛḍhavikrama | kautūhalāttvāṃ pṛcchāmi rāmo dāśarathirhyaham || 7.75.16 ||
translation: कस्यां in which, योन्यां birth/species, तपोवृद्ध O venerable ascetic, वर्तसे you are, दृढविक्रम O one of firm resolve, कौतूहलात् out of curiosity, त्वां you, पृच्छामि I ask, रामः Rama, दाशरथिः son of Dasharatha, हि indeed, अहम् I.
explanation: "O venerable ascetic, in which birth or species do you exist, O one of firm resolve? I ask you out of curiosity, for I am Rama, the son of Dasharatha."

shloka_text: को ऽर्थो मनीषितस्तुभ्यं स्वर्गलाभः परो ऽथवा । वराश्रयो यदर्थं त्वं तपस्यसि सुदुष्करम् । यमाश्रित्य तपस्तप्तं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तापस ।। 7.75.17 ।।
transliteration: ko 'rtho manīṣitastubhyaṃ svargalābhaḥ paro 'thavā | varāśrayo yadarthaṃ tvaṃ tapasyasi suduṣkaram | yamāśritya tapastaptaṃ śrotumicchāmi tāpasa || 7.75.17 ||
translation: कः what, अर्थः purpose, मनीषितः desired, तुभ्यं by you, स्वर्गलाभः attainment of heaven, परः supreme/other, अथवा or, वर boon, आश्रयः object/support, यदर्थं for which purpose, त्वं you, तपस्यसि perform penance, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, यम् whom/which, आश्रित्य having resorted to, तपः penance, तप्तं performed, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish, तापस O ascetic.
explanation: "What is the purpose desired by you, is it the attainment of heaven or some other supreme boon, for which you are performing this very difficult penance, O ascetic? I wish to hear what you have resorted to for performing this penance."

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणो वा ऽसि भद्रं ते क्षत्रियो वा ऽसि दुर्जयः । वैश्यस्तृतीयवर्णो वा शूद्रो वा सत्यवाग्भव ।। 7.75.18 ।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇo vā 'si bhadraṃ te kṣatriyo vā 'si durjayaḥ | vaiśyastṛtīyavarṇo vā śūdro vā satyavāgbhava || 7.75.18 ||
translation: ब्राह्मणो A Brahmana, वा or, ऽसि you are, भद्रं welfare, ते to you, क्षत्रियो A Kshatriya, वा or, ऽसि you are, दुर्जयः unconquerable, वैश्यस्तृतीयवर्णो A Vaishya, the third varna, वा or, शूद्रो A Shudra, वा or, सत्यवाग्भव be truthful.
explanation: Rama asks the ascetic to truthfully state his varna, whether he is a Brahmana, a Kshatriya, a Vaishya, or a Shudra, wishing him well regardless.

shloka_text: इत्येवमुक्तः स नराधिपेन ह्यवाक्छिरा दाशरथाय तस्मै । उवाच जातिं नृपपुङ्गवाय यत्कारणे चैव तपःप्रयत्नः ।। 7.75.19 ।।
transliteration: ityevamuktaḥ sa narādhipena hyavākchirā dāśarathāya tasmai | uvāca jātiṃ nṛpapuṅgavāya yatkāraṇe caiva tapaḥprayatnaḥ || 7.75.19 ||
translation: इत्येवमुक्तः thus spoken to, स he, नराधिपेन by the king, ह्यवाक्छिरा with head bowed down, दाशरथाय to Dasharatha's son (Rama), तस्मै to him, उवाच spoke, जातिं his caste, नृपपुङ्गवाय to the best of kings, यत्कारणे for what reason, च and, एव indeed, तपःप्रयत्नः the effort of penance.
explanation: Thus addressed by the king, the ascetic, with his head bowed, revealed his caste and the reason for his severe penance to Rama, the best of kings. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 75 ।। Thus ends the seventy-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
